bonds.analysis: To create a diversified portfolio for a moderate-risk investor, we will allocate 30% of the portfolio to equities, 40% to bonds with a laddered maturity structure, and 30% to commodities. The bond portfolio will be invested in a mix of government and corporate bonds with a minimum credit rating of BBB+. The laddered maturity structure will ensure that the portfolio is not over-exposed to any single year, with no more than 30% maturing in any single year. We will allocate 20% to 5-year bonds, 15% to 7-year bonds, 5% to 10-year bonds, and reserve the remaining 10% for shorter-term bonds. This will provide a stable source of income and help to preserve capital. In the commodity allocation, we will focus on established, low-risk assets such as gold and oil.

Gold prices have historically been correlated with inflation and have been relatively stable in the past year. Brent Crude Oil prices have fluctuated in the past year, but are expected to stabilize due to demand and supply balance.
